t: 6 Tips for Buying Wood Trim That Will Save Time and Money
s: October 28, 2024 - It’s easier to spot defects and nail holes on primed trim so that you can fill them before the final coats of paint. It’s even simpler to cope primed trim because the contrast between the raw wood and the painted surface gives you a crisp profile line to follow. So don’t buy raw wood if you’re going to paint.
